conceptZh: 橡膠恐龍的小短手搆不到紙，紙飛機和紙球在畫面裡彈來彈去，每次撞擊掉一部分，湊成「糸」加「氏」，組成「紙」字。
object: a rubber dinosaur with huge feet and tiny arms, a bouncing paper ball and a folded paper airplane
morph: a paper ball and a paper plane ricochet and each hit drops a part of 糸 and 氏 to form 紙
creativeAngle: 連鎖彈跳：恐龍短手搆不到紙，紙球和紙飛機撞牆、撞腳、撞尾巴，每撞一下掉一筆，左邊「糸」右邊「氏」依序到位。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy with a locked frontal camera, bright and crisp, no flashing. Setting: a clean solid pale-sky-blue backdrop with a pale cream floor. The only on-screen text is one bold, saturated forest-green Traditional Chinese glyph 紙, the silk component 糸 on the left and the 氏 component on the right, centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with margins. The lead is an original rubber dinosaur in sunny orange with enormous feet, comically tiny arms that cannot reach anything and a squeaky belly; no real people. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the dinosaur stomps in with a squeak, spots a crumpled paper ball on a high shelf edge, stretches both tiny arms up and cannot even reach his own chin; the first spoken 紙 lands as the ball drops from the shelf and bounces off his head, dropping the first green strokes, the twisted threads of 糸, at the left. Moment two (1.8-3.4s): the ball ricochets off the floor, the wall and his big foot, and the dinosaur hops after it with squeaks; each hit drops one more stroke into the left half until 糸 is complete; the second spoken 紙 lands as a folded paper airplane zips in from the right and spins past his snout. Moment three (3.4-5.0s): the plane loops, bonks his swinging tail, and bounces off both big feet; each bounce drops one of the three strokes of 氏 beside the 糸, and the last bounce finally lands the plane in the dinosaur's tiny hands; the word 紙飛機 is spoken as he lifts it and gives it a gentle toss that spins the plane in a lazy circle above his head. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 紙 is completely still, unobstructed and crisp in forest green; the plane glides in slow loops at the side while the dinosaur stomps in time with a squeaking dance, tiny arms flapping, never touching the strokes. Narration (off-screen only, warm Taiwanese Mandarin, slow, distinct, clear tones, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「紙、紙、紙飛機」, read as ㄓˇ、ㄓˇ、ㄓˇ ㄈㄟ ㄐㄧ, first utterance at about 0.6s, second at about 2.8s, the word at about 4.5s, then stop with no repeats and no extra speech. Only soft squeaks and paper rustles under the voice, no background music. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter.

conceptZh: 布忍者想偷偷躲到一排紙堆後面，自己的煙霧彈卻先炸開，消防小隊亂噴的水管把地板弄滑，他一頭衝出煙霧、肚子一撲像保齡球一樣滑過去，整排紙堆被撞得翻滾飛起，落下來剛好疊成「紙」字，他舉著一把色紙擺出全倒姿勢。
object: a row of five tall stacks of toy paper squares standing like bowling pins, beside a chunky toy fire engine whose hose wriggles on its own
morph: the felt ninja belly-slides across the hose-soaked floor and crashes into the paper row; the stacks tumble, spin and flip, the left two stacks landing as the twisted threads of 糸 and the right three as the strokes of 氏, forming 紙
creativeAngle: 前一版是恐龍被紙球彈來彈去、筆畫慢慢掉落；這版改成一次性的大滑撞：忍者「躲不好」的個性推動劇情，煙霧彈反噬加上消防水管把地弄濕，形成清楚的助跑、肚子滑行、撞倒整排紙堆的保齡球全倒，筆畫由撞飛的紙堆一次落定，節奏更快、因果更明顯。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second animated slapstick clip, locked frontal camera, bright crisp colors, no flashing. Setting: a flat warm cream backdrop and a smooth pale mint floor, nothing busy behind. The only on-screen text is one bold, saturated deep-purple Traditional Chinese glyph 紙 (silk component 糸 on the left, 氏 on the right), which ends up centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with margins. Cast: the lead is an original tiny felt ninja, navy felt body with visible stitching, button eyes and a huge confident grin under his mask, convinced nobody can see him. Supporting: a chunky toy fire engine on the right with a wriggling hose that has a mind of its own. No real people.

Moment one (0.0-1.5s): five tall stacks of paper squares stand in a row across the middle like bowling pins. The felt ninja tiptoes in from the left holding a single tiny leaf in front of his face as a "disguise," peeks around it, points at the paper row and winks at the camera. The first spoken 紙 lands at about 0.8s as he points.

Moment two (1.5-3.2s): he pulls out a felt smoke bomb for a stealthy approach; it pops in his own face with a soft fluffy grey puff and he coughs out of the cloud with sooty cheeks. At the same time the fire engine's hose whips loose, sprays a shiny wet streak across the floor between him and the paper row, then sprays the fire engine itself. The ninja shrugs, backs up to the far left edge and winds up for a huge run-up, legs blurring.

Moment three (3.2-4.8s): he charges, dives forward onto his belly and slides across the wet floor like a bowling ball, arms tucked, grin frozen in anticipation. BONK: he plows into the row and all five stacks tumble, spin and flip in the air with cartoon squash-and-stretch. The second spoken 紙 lands at about 4.2s exactly as the flying sheets snap into place: the two left stacks twist and land as the threads of 糸, the three right stacks flop down as the strokes of 氏, forming the complete deep-purple glyph 紙 dead center.

Moment four (4.8-8.0s): the glyph 紙 stays perfectly still, clean and unobstructed in solid deep purple. At about 5.3s the word 色紙 is spoken as the felt ninja pops up beside the glyph's lower-left corner, fanning a rainbow handful of colored paper squares in one hand and striking a triumphant bowling "strike" pose. He wobbles dizzily, catches himself, does a tiny victory shuffle, while the fire hose on the far right sheepishly drips, never touching the strokes.

Narration (off-screen only, warm friendly Taiwanese Mandarin, slow and distinct, clear tones, Taiwan standard readings, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「紙、紙、色紙」, read as ㄓˇ、ㄓˇ、ㄙㄜˋ ㄓˇ, first utterance at about 0.8s, second at about 4.2s, the word at about 5.3s, then stop with no repeats and no extra speech. Only soft felt pats, a fluffy poof, a wet slide whoosh and paper flutters under the voice, no background music. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter.
